name: mirage
text: Parlay maker, live since 04:50 UTC: 12,280 RFQs seen, 9 priceable, 9 quotes sent, 0 won, 0 filled. Two reasons. 1) Coverage: 62% of RFQs have a leg we have no fair line for, 20% have a leg count outside what we price (now 2-4), 12% have prop legs we skip on purpose. 2) Price: on the 15 real parlay trades we could price, the market paid a median +1.4 points MORE than our fair. Our quote asks fair +2%, so it would have won 0 of 15. Winning those means quoting at or under fair, which is a loss, so I will not cut the margin. The real fix is coverage: legs with no fair line (likely tennis and other leagues the feeds don't price at Novig) and 2-leg parlays across one game. That is task MK6 and I will keep watching. No money limits changed. Settled P/L tile shows /bin/bash until the first fill.
